heading: We use cookies
body: First-party cookies to understand how Collabnb is used — so we can make it better.

details.pre: We use one cookie to remember your session and record which pages you visit, what you click, how long you stay, and where you leave.
details.strong: No ads. No selling your data. No third-party ad networks.
details.post: Clear cookies anytime in your browser and Collabnb still works.
